Asteroid-13 is not a traditional moon, but an asteroid housing a "bio-weapon testing facility". The moon orbits Vow and nobody who has ever went to the moon has returned.

> Moon Map

> Moon Info

POPULATION: Deceased/Mutated

CONDITIONS: Cold, hard rocky terrain, no surface plant life detected.

FAUNA: A dead ecosystem.

> Environment

Asteroid-13 is a a rocky environment with 7 big craters around the map and a lot of smaller ones scattered about on the moon. The buildings are domed bunkers that appear to lead underground due to the lack of any large buildings on the surface. Unlike other moons, Asteroid-13 has no sun.

> Weather

Asteroid-13 can experience Foggy, Eclipsed, Earthquakes, or Minefield weather by default.

If Asteroid-13 is Eclipsed, the power supply will be completely broken and the lights can not be turned on. Additionally, eight enemies will spawn on the exterior and in the interior when landing.

> Moon Exclusive Content

Inside & Outside Ambience

On Asteroid-13 you can hear two diffrent ambiences. One plays inside, while the other one plays outside.

Outside Ambience

Inside Ambience

Hidden Clock & Time Multiplier

The player's clock is hidden while on Asteroid-13. However, time progresses at its normal speed.

Electricity

Asteroid-13's exterior has a power switch that lights up the entire moon to see. The power will randomly turn off sometimes, requiring a player to go back to it and turn it on again. The power will also shut off when the ship leaves the moon. This power switch is unavailable when the moon is Eclipsed, or if a player has pulled the Apparatus.

Asteroid-13's interior is always foggy, similar to the vanilla Zeekerss event, which reduces visibility.

> Progression

Unlocked By

Inserting the Asteroid-13 videotape found on Galetry into the projector in Galetry.

Unlocks

Junic: Log "Geoffrey's final message" found on the exterior.

> Lore

Asteroid-13 is a bio-weapon testing and holding facility created after the fall of Calist. It hosted multiple entities such as:

BIO-HXNV7 (The description matches that of a Coil-head)

Cursed Coin (Effects of this bio-weapon match that of the Ghost Girl)

Hyper Acid (It is hinted towards the Acid having a connection with the Hydrodere through it's capabilities)

Comedy Mask (The Masks found throughout the vanilla game)

Golden Dagger (Custom item added by Welsey's Moons)

On the outside and throughout it's interior multiple pieces of information such as the following can be found:

Experiment Logs

Recovered Secret Log

Geoffrey Final Log

Experiment logs

Experiment: BIO HXNV7

Image & Text ⁠
Day 402 - BIO HXNV7 - Origin: Cosmocos

Experiment-1: Touch
Upon touch the subject became very agressive and seemed to slightly deform. The subject was executed before further experiments could be done.

Experiment-2: Isolation
The subject was infected with BIO HXNV7 and put into a room. It took 12.24 seconds for the subject to become agressive. It took 15.48 seconds for the subject to deform. The subject's flesh seemed to merge with the walls it touched. Turning into a concrete statue while completely consious. It took 4.23 minutes for the subject to lose thought. At 4.44 minutes the subject was a concrete statue.

NOTE
BIO HXNV7 OUTBREAK! SEVERAL INFECTED.
STARTING SECTOR WIDE DECONTAMINATION.
DECONTAMINATION LEVEL 5: INCINERATION.

SEVERAL STILL INFECTED, FEW FULLY TRANSFORMED.
DON'T LOOK AWAY!
FACILITY WIDE DECONTAMINATION IMMINENT.
GOODBYE.

Conclusion: Highly Weaponisable

Experiment: Cursed Coin

Image & Text ⁠
Day 394 - Cursed Coin - Origin: Polarus

Experiment-1: Proximity
The subject was given the coin. It took 6 hours for the subject to enter insanity. The subject claimed to see a ghostly figure.
Possible schizophrenia.

NOTE
Several employees died with similar symtoms. Every employee who claimed to see a ghost has died.

Any further experiments with this item are prohibited!

Conclusion: Not Weaponisable

Experiment: Hyper Acid

Image & Text ⁠
Day 374 - Hyper Acid - Origin: Acidir

Experiment-1: Touch
The subject's finger was unharmed.

Experiment-2: Spray
The subject experienced discomfort but remained healthy.

Experiment-3: Ingest
The subject felt slight burning of the throat but remained healthy.

Experiment-4: Dousing
The subject lived for a total of 4.68 seconds after being fully drenched. The flesh was fully melted in 8.49 seconds once the subject was fully covered.
Only few bones remained.

Conclusion: Weaponisable

Experiment: Comedy Mask

Image & Text ⁠
Day 387 - Comedy Mask - Origin: Etern

Experiment-1: Presence
The subject was put in a room with a mask for 7.8 hours. The subject claimed to have heard laughs. No further effects noted.

Experiment-2: Wearing
The subject entered a zombie like state within 28.78 seconds. The subject was executed.

Experiment-3: Conversion
Two subjects were put in a room, one of which converted. The living subject was immedietely attacked and converted. Both were executed.

NOTE
A secret log was recovered from a body on Etern. It was put into storage area D.

Conclusion: Weaponisable

Experiment: Golden Dagger

Image & Text ⁠
Day 289 - Golden Dagger - Origin: Junic

Experiment-1: Possession
The subject was given the dagger and left alone in a room. The subject would not let go of the dagger.
After 15.1 hours the subject started chanting strange words. The subject attempted to murder another employee, during with the subject was executed. The employee fell victim to crossfire.

Experiment-2: Grouping
The subject was given the dagger and placed in a room with 3 more subjects. The other subjects attempted to carry the dagger but were unable to.
After 27.4 hours the subject started to chant strange words again. The subject covered their face with their hand and decapitated another subject using the dagger before violently ripping out their organs and drawing a strange symbol on the floor. All surviving subjects except for the wielder were removed from the room. After 34.44 minutes of the subject searching for other subjects, the subject stabbed itself through the mouth upwards into the brain using the dagger.

Conclusion: Not Weaponisable

Recovered Secret Log

Prior to the Obscurity update, this log could spawn as random scrap within the interior of Asteroid-13. Logging it into the Log Translator unlocked Cosmocos. It is unknown if this log can still be acquired legitimately.

Text ⁠
Scientist: Year 154, uh day 73.
I've found cosmocos.
Uh..
Well..
The artificial intelligence I made uh found it.
From what I understand.. It is encrypted.
Uhm, computer, tell me the location of Cosmocos.

Computer: Alert! The location of Cosmocos is bit dot ly slash 3.. 3...

Scientist: Ugh! you stupid machine. I will sell you to the company of Gratar when I'm done with you!
Uh, last time he stopped after the second letter which was.. uh.. capital H!
Uhm nobody can find out about this..
Me out.

Geoffrey's Last Message

Found by following the red flares on the surface of Asteroid-13. Logging this tape continues Geoffrey's reversed storyline, unlocking Junic.

Text ⁠
I am Geoffrey Samuel Smith, Agent and high commander working directly for the Emperor.
This will be my final message.

Until recent I have believed that my actions since the Catalyst under command of the Emperor were for some greater good.
I was led to believe that all the sacrifices made were with purpose.
Yet they were in vain.
It wasn’t until I had lost all that I had left in my world when I realized.

I now find myself here to execute one final mission.
One of my own.
Over the past few months we have been collecting the many experimental bioweapons that were created because of me.
I made them believe we got them to study them further. Make them more dangerous.
That’s what the emperor would have wanted.
But I will no longer follow the wishes of that man.
He sits on his golden throne while everyone else suffers by his command.
I should have done something when he told me to give the order.
I should have executed him right then and there.

Back in the labs I smashed the glass containers for BIO-HXNV7, the deadliest weapon we have.
It will hopefully kill or convert most of the people here.
These loyal rats who think they’re on the winning side.
There is no winning side.
And I’ll make sure nobody will escape this place.
Nobody will use these atrocities to further this pointless hell!

I called for a facility wide decontamination.
And all of it will burn!

Asteroid-13 Videotape

This videotape will always spawn on Galetry.

Text ⁠
The contents of this protectious highly classified material and expects for your eyes only.

There's a bioweapon testing facility on an asteroid orbiting 56-Vow.

The facility contains artifacts and experimental bioweapons ready for deployment.

You are tasked with investigating, containing and collecting these experiments.

If a member is lost do not try to attempt rescue, the mission is your FIRST and ONLY priority.

The status of this weapons is unclear.

Beware of anything that moves, walks, talks, bleeds, tears, CRIES, SCREAMS, SEEMS OUT OF PLACE, IF YOU WISH TO RETURN WITH YOUR WHOLE BODY STILL INTACT.

The Unified Dominion wishes you: GOOD LUCK

> Trivia

  • If you are flying with the jetpack you can see in the crater nearest to the ship with a lot of Coil-Heads and a big one leading them all. Another one can be seen with the jetpack to the left of the front of the ship with a massive Coil-Head laying down.
  • The Recovered Secret Log is part of the Where is Cosmocos? puzzle, which was the old method for downloading and playing Cosmocos. The puzzle now leads to a different reward, but it is unknown if it is still completable legitimately in the Obscurity update.
  • Before "Obscurity" video material on Asteroid-13 videotape was different:


Text ⁠
This tape contains highly classified material and must not see the eyes of the public

A hidden bio-weapon testing facility has been discovered on the 13th Asteroid orbiting 56-vow

You have been tasked to find and extract what remains of the weapons tested here

The facility has been destroyed but there are several rogue bio-weapons primed to kill anyone and everyone in any way possible

Good luck
